# Firnaz Luztian Adiansyah — portfolio full summary

> Static personal site showcasing frontend engineering work. Content is authored in EN/ID/JP locale packs; `/` and `/portfolio` are canonical. `/dashboard` and `/project` are legacy/WIP.

## About the engineer

Software engineer with experience across enterprise and startup product teams (including Telkom Indonesia, Oromico, Addon Tech). Focus areas: React/Next.js, TypeScript, performance, design systems, and AI-assisted product work.

## Site architecture

- Next.js 15 App Router under `src/app/`
- Feature UI in `src/containers/portfolio/`
- Resume content: `src/constants/locale-resume/{en,id,jp}.ts`
- UI chrome: `src/constants/locale-ui/{en,id,jp}.ts`
- Deploy: GitHub Actions → static `./out` on GitHub Pages (no Node server APIs)

## Sibling projects (AI)

- Vinove — cinematic companion chat; SAFE_MODE classifier guardrails; encrypted messages
- Vibe House — paste URL → PSI + vibe-coded estimate; SSRF + untrusted HTML hardening; signal-keyed rubric retrieval
